results.question: Why did David Allen eliminate most references to specific software applications in the revised edition?
results.subject: Productivity
results.answer: David Allen eliminated most references to specific software applications because the rapid rate of innovation in the digital world means that any particular program can easily become outdated, upgraded, or replaced by new technology by the time a reader encounters it. Instead of focusing on specific tools, he opted to provide a general model that helps readers evaluate the usefulness of any tool they choose. This approach ensures the book remains relevant despite the constant evolution of digital and mobile technologies.
